name: Matplotlib 3D Voxel Rendering with Internal Faces
definition: A technique to render all voxels in a 3D volume, including occluded internal faces, by overriding the standard Matplotlib `voxels` method. The standard method only renders surface faces, hiding internal voxels even if they have alpha transparency.
summary: Matplotlib 3D Voxel Rendering with Internal Faces renders occluded internal voxel boundaries by overriding the standard voxels method, unlike wireframe highlighters that only mark existing structures.
